title: Add tools for the way you work
heading:
Add tools for
the way you work.
intro: You can extend Situate with your own tools, called plugins.
capabilities: Plugins can carry out tasks automatically according to your instructions—for example, prepare a project summary. They can also turn your data into dashboards and custom views, such as a task board.
suggestionsWithFiles: Here are a few ideas based on your working method and imported content.
suggestionsWithoutFiles: Here are a few ideas based on the way you want to work.
choiceHelp: Choose what to build after setup, save as a note for later, or discard. You can also finish without choosing anything.
inspiration: You’re not limited to these suggestions. Later, you can return to a saved idea or describe an entirely different plugin you’d like Situate to build.
working: Finding ideas to get you started…
workingWithFiles: We’re looking at your working method and imported content for plugins you could set up now.
workingWithoutFiles: We’re looking at your working method for plugins you could set up now.
waitingHelp: You can finish setup without waiting for suggestions.
error: Plugin ideas couldn’t be prepared. Try again, or finish setup without them.
empty: No plugin ideas to suggest right now. You can still create your own later.
restoreDetail: You can finish setup without starting plugins, or restore AI access to develop them.
saveOne: 1 idea will be saved as a note.
saveMany: {count} ideas will be saved as notes.
capacity: When you finish setup, Situate will start building your selected plugins using your AI access. Each has its own chat in the conversation list, where you can follow the work and ask for changes.
offline: AI access is unavailable. Restore access, or choose Save for later or Discard for the plugins selected to build now.
saveError: Your plugin ideas couldn’t be saved. Your choices are still here and no development has started. Try finishing setup again.

controls.detail: Suggestions use fictional working instructions and imported files. No AI requests run. Choices create simulated notes and development chats only when setup is finished.
controls.refreshHelp: Reloading replaces the suggestions and clears their choices. Resizing the preview preserves them.
